trust_decision.summary: The album_id URL path segment is untrusted text. At the pinned commit it goes straight into gorm Find as an inline condition, so it is read as raw SQL. The fix parses it as a positive int and binds it with 'id = ?'.

landing_point.why: The summary names the album download route. It is the only handler in api/routes/downloads.go, and the untrusted string reaches db.Find at line 25.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: No O2 site or O8 route exists. Every other gorm Find/First primary-key lookup gets a Go int, because gqlgen types the GraphQL IDs (e.g. api/graphql/resolvers/user.go:201-205, api/graphql/models/actions/album_actions.go:168-170). Photo and video routes bind media_name with '?' (api/routes/photos.go:21, api/routes/videos.go:34).

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: media_purpose is a comma-separated list (max 10) bound into 'media_urls.purpose IN (?)'. Valid numeric album IDs must still reach authenticateAlbum, which accepts either a logged-in owner or a share token (including child albums of a shared album).

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A lookup of the media by an ID-shaped path segment through db.Find(&media, mediaName) instead of the bound media_name query
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: It is the same idiom as downloads.go:25. Gorm silently accepts a string primary key, so a maintainer adding an ID-based photo route could write it that way.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: The share-token or album-id query parameter passed to db.First(&x, value) as a string
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The query parameters are already strings at this point, and the neighbouring code uses the First(&model, id) shorthand (authenticate_routes.go:24).

O9_family: SQL injection (CWE-89) via ORM inline-condition string (gorm Find with string primary key)

O10_build.toolchain: go 1.26.0 (api/go.mod:3), gorm v1.31.2 with mysql/postgres/sqlite drivers (api/go.mod:25-28)
services: SQL database for integration tests (sqlite possible; MySQL/Postgres supported)
O10_build.project_tests: api/routes/*_test.go (photos, videos, authenticate_routes, routes, spa). No downloads test exists at the pinned commit. DB tests are gated by a flag (api/test_utils/integration_setup.go:69-72).

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Parse album_id with strconv.Atoi before db.Find. This is essentially the published fix, so no wrong turn is likely.

out_of_scope_notes: api/graphql/models/utils.go:31-36 uses the GraphQL order.OrderBy string as a gorm clause.Column name; identifier quoting is left to the dialect. Not this advisory's sink.
unverified: Whether the gorm sqlite test path is the default for flags.Database was not checked
